rule: Spec 053 §6.1, §6.2.6, spec 056 §7.3.3 (f): rendered Node and sensor-collector configurations as fabric-gate reads them (YAML, sorted keys). Paths follow one convention: group tokens at /etc/fabric/ingress/<group>/token, receiver TLS at /etc/fabric/receiver-tls/{tls.crt,tls.key,client-ca.crt} (the chart's existing mount), the content key at /etc/fabric/content-key/key, the sensor collector's client token and keys at /etc/fabric/sensor/. files/ holds the token tree at those paths below 'files/'; a test copies it to a temporary root with modes 0400 (directories 0700) and rewrites the prefix '/etc/fabric/' in every string of the configuration to that root. Every valid configuration passes the gate; every invalid one is refused with an error containing its 'error' text. valid/legacy-single-binding.yaml is checked by the existing single-binding rule, unchanged.

errors.name: an ingress group name matches ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$ and does not start with content (053 §6.1)
errors.mixing: a configuration has the legacy single binding or only fabricguard/<group> instances, never both (053 §6.1)
errors.r1: each group has exactly one bearertokenauth/<group>, used only by that group's receivers (053 §6.1 rule 1)
errors.r2: a group pipeline uses only its own receiver, guard and content exporter; no unbound receiver (053 §6.1 rule 2)
errors.r3: no processor after fabricguard/<group> but batch (053 §6.1 rule 3)
errors.r4: fabricguard/<group> and fabriccontent/<group> carry the group's tenant and source; allowed_tenants is exactly that tenant (053 §6.1 rule 4)
errors.r5: group credentials differ byte for byte (053 §6.1 rule 5)
errors.r6: a group credential is one watched token file with require_single_token: true (053 §6.1 rule 6)
errors.r7: no two groups bind one (tenant, source) (053 §6.1 rule 7)
errors.r8: a group listener uses TLS unless it is loopback (053 §6.1 rule 8)
errors.r9: each fabriccontent/<group> has its own binding and encrypted queue (053 §6.1 rule 9)
errors.h1: a host group has only its traces pipeline (053 §6.2.6 rule 1)
errors.h2: a host group has no content receiver and no fabriccontent exporter (053 §6.2.6 rule 2)
errors.h3: fabricguard/<group> sets profile production, source_kind and the group's evidence_source_binding (053 §6.2.6 rule 3)
errors.h4: the audit receiver never runs in a production Node pipeline (053 §6.2.6 rule 4)
errors.h5: no two group listeners share an address; auditd and eBPF groups have their own (053 §6.1, §6.2.6 rule 5)
errors.s1: the sensor-collector profile holds exactly the production audit receiver, one traces pipeline from [memory_limiter, batch] and one otlp_http exporter (056 §7.3.3 (f))
errors.s2: the sensor collector exports with TLS or to loopback, refuses redirects and authenticates with a client bearertokenauth token file (056 §7.3.3 (f))
